items.title: Meta launches Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp subscriptions, with more to come, including AI plans

_source_config.name: TechCrunch
_source_config.reason: 创投科技媒体，需筛选AI创业、产品相关

items.ai_target_audience: Product managers, UX/UI designers, and tech strategists interested in monetization and platform evolution.
items.ai_key_insights: Meta's subscription rollout introduces new payment flows, tiered experiences, and AI-driven personalization, directly impacting interface design for onboarding, upsells, and feature gating.
items.ai_recommendation: 深入解析订阅制如何重塑社交产品界面，为设计师提供支付流、分层体验与AI整合的实战参考，助你把握变现设计趋势。

items.title: 科技公司CEO们显然正饱受人工智能妄想症的困扰

_source_config.name: TechCrunch
_source_config.reason: 创投科技媒体，需筛选AI创业、产品相关

items.ai_target_audience: 关注AI技术趋势及其对产品设计影响的UI/UX设计师、产品经理和科技行业观察者
items.ai_key_insights: 揭露科技公司高层对AI能力存在不切实际的扩张预期，可能导致资源错配并忽视用户体验的真实需求；呼吁以更务实的态度将AI融入设计流程。
items.ai_recommendation: 帮助设计师看清AI炒作背后的盲点，避免被管理层妄想带偏设计方向。

items.title: How to get wired internet without running ethernet cables

_source_config.name: Wired
_source_config.reason: 科技文化媒体，需筛选AI+设计深度报道

items.ai_target_audience: homeowners, renters, and tech-savvy consumers seeking stable wired internet without extensive cabling
items.ai_key_insights: Explains alternatives like MoCA (coaxial), powerline adapters, and mesh systems with Ethernet backhaul; practical setup tips and pros/cons for each method.
items.ai_recommendation: 对需要优化家庭网络但不想布线普通用户实用，对UI/UX设计师直接帮助有限，除非涉及智能家居或远程办公环境搭建。

items.title: Xreal’s New $299 ‘xbx’ Smart Glasses Channel Xbox Vibes

_source_config.name: Wired
_source_config.reason: 科技文化媒体，需筛选AI+设计深度报道

items.ai_target_audience: Tech-savvy designers and product developers interested in the intersection of gaming, wearable displays, and affordable augmented reality experiences.
items.ai_key_insights: Xreal's xbx glasses at $299 emphasize gaming culture with Xbox-inspired styling, lightweight display for media/gaming, and hint at future AR interface design directions for mass-market wearables.
items.ai_recommendation: 这款299美元的智能眼镜以Xbox风格切入大众游戏市场，为设计师提供了可穿戴界面在娱乐场景中的轻量化、亲民化设计参考。
